findings.what: The #c= carrier: (a) adoptFragmentId runs on every page and takes a link's id whenever storage holds no cart, also where storage works: a crafted link makes a new visitor's browser use someone else's cart (3/3 visitors adopted, their adds went into it, ×3 → ×6); the other side sees and can change the cart until checkout. (b) On the cart page, without storage, the header's 'סל' is a same-document fragment navigation: '/cart/#c=<id>' stays in the address and in the tab's history until the page loads again. (c) The browser's own History database keeps '/cart/#c=<id>' and '/checkout/#c=<id>' (replaceState rewrites the tab's entry only).
findings.fix: (a) adopt only when storage is not usable (`!usable()`) and only on /cart/ and /checkout/; (b) never append to a link to the current document (or read and remove on hashchange); (c) carry the id in window.name instead of the address (same tab, not in the address, the history, a referrer or a server), or document (c) as accepted for no-storage browsers. An e2e for each.

findings.severity: medium-low; (a) before HD_PUBLIC=1 recommended, (b) before the story is public
findings.what: A write made without the saved cart replaces its quantity: (a) the shop, after a failed load: a saved vase ×2, 'הוספה לסל' → ×1 on the server, header 'סל (1)' (same id: no new cart); (b) the story, before its load (GET 2.5 s): 'המראה כולו לסל' writes absolute quantities: basket ×3 → ×1, and 'already in the cart' is not seen: the old bug, in the story's own cart.
findings.fix: (b) the story's add and addLook wait for its load (as the shop's addToCart waits for `inflight`); (a) after a failed load, an add first loads again and refuses with the error if it still fails (or an add-by-delta on the server). An e2e for each.

findings.severity: medium-low; before the story is public
findings.what: The story on a failed load (500, 503, no network) shows the count '0' and the cart sheet 'הסל ריק.' over a saved cart of 6, with no error and no retry. S21's 'never empty' holds in the shop only.
findings.fix: load() tells 404/409 (truly gone) from a failure; on a failure the count stays blank (not busy), the sheet shows the error and 'לנסות שוב'. An e2e like the shop's.

findings.what: A page restored from the back/forward cache keeps its count: product 'סל (1)', the cart page made it 2, back: 'סל (1)', still after 4 s (the cache is on in customers' browsers; Playwright turns it off). No pageshow handler in the shop or the story.
findings.fix: on pageshow with persisted, load the cart again (shop and story); an e2e with the cache on (tools/bfcache.mjs shows how).

findings.what: Log redaction residuals beyond ת64's claim: an upper-case run before a Camel word (DANAGat, XMLDana); a value without its space (danagat, TELAVIV, נועהבןדוד); encoded forms (%D7%A0… anywhere, \u05e0… in a field); a change of script with no separator (Noaלוי, ID:נועהX in a field).
findings.fix: split also between an upper-case run and a Camel word (/(\p{Lu})(?=\p{Lu}\p{Ll})/); add the space-less form of each multi-word value; decode %XX and \uXXXX before matching; treat a change of script as a boundary.

findings.what: house.spec (ת22) retries Enter every 5 s whether or not the hotspot is hydrated. Measured: no lost press (24/24 single presses open, ≤ 3.0 s), but a press lost after hydration (a focus regression) would now pass.
findings.fix: retry only while the hotspot has no listener (not hydrated), or wait for hydration and then press once with 15 s, as the other house test does.

notes.what: For the designer: during the up-to-4 s wait the link is only aria-busy; no CSS shows it (no style for [aria-busy] anywhere), so a tap seems to do nothing.

An add whose PUT takes over 4 s: the move goes at ~4.3 s, the cart page says 'הסל ריק.' and 'סל (0)' while the server gets the line later (keepalive) and the page never updates. A known limit; cheap: carry a 'write pending' mark (window.name) so the cart page reads once more after a beat.
Without JS the prerendered cart and checkout stay in the loading state forever (aria-busy, no words). Before S21 they said 'empty'. A noscript line would say what to do.
